method: Get-WinEvent: actual Windows System event log, read-only; Event Viewer GUI not used
correlation_window: 5 minutes before through 15 minutes after selected event
sanitization: Only selected time/provider/event ID/level retained; no computer names, account IDs, SIDs, addresses, record IDs or raw messages/XML
timestamp_privacy: Exact dates and timestamps withheld from this public copy; original evidence retained privately.
